Is there any flexibility on the salary?
Your salary is too low for me.
cards.explain: Is there any flexibility on… — вежливо и сильно 💼

cards.front: Would you be open to a review after six months?
cards.back: Вы были бы готовы пересмотреть условия через полгода?

audio.text: We can't go higher on the base salary, but we could add a signing bonus.

options: Бонус при подписании вместо повышения оклада

audio.text: Based on my research, the going rate for this role in Madrid is around thirty-two thousand.

cards.pattern: Is there any flexibility on + noun?

cards.text: Thank you for the offer. Is there any flexibility on the salary?
cards.tr: Спасибо за предложение. Есть ли гибкость по зарплате?

cards.text: I'm really excited about the role. Based on the going rate, I was hoping for thirty-two thousand. Would you be open to meeting me halfway?
cards.tr: Я очень рад(а) этой роли. Исходя из рыночной ставки, я рассчитывал(а) на 32 тысячи. Вы были бы готовы пойти мне навстречу?

n1.say: We're happy to offer you the position at twenty-eight thousand a year.
n1.tr: Мы рады предложить вам позицию с окладом 28 тысяч в год.

choices.text: Thank you, I'm really excited about the role. Is there any flexibility on the salary?

choices.feedback: Честно, но без аргумента. Добавь рынок и цифры 📊

n2.say: There might be some room. What did you have in mind?
n2.tr: Возможно, есть пространство. Что вы имели в виду?

choices.text: Based on the going rate for similar roles, I was hoping for thirty-two thousand.
I'd like to make a counteroffer of thirty-two thousand, given my experience in customer support.

n3.say: Thirty-two is above our budget. The most we can do is thirty.
n3.tr: 32 — выше нашего бюджета. Максимум, что можем, — 30.

choices.text: I understand. Could you meet me halfway at thirty-one, with a review after six months?

choices.feedback: Слишком жёстко, если это не настоящий deal-breaker 🙂

n4.say: Let me check with the team. Apart from salary, is there anything else that matters to you?
n4.tr: Я уточню у команды. Помимо зарплаты, есть ли что-то ещё важное для вас?

choices.text: Yes. Two remote days a week are non-negotiable for me.
Flexible hours would mean a lot. Would you be open to that?

n5.say: That sounds reasonable. I'll send you an updated offer tomorrow.
n5.tr: Звучит разумно. Завтра пришлю обновлённое предложение.
